name: co2rr-catalysts
topic: Electrochemical CO2 reduction (CO2RR) catalysts and their measured performance
scope: Primary experimental or computational studies of CO2RR catalysts that report at least one performance value (Faradaic efficiency, current density, stability) or a computed reaction energetics. Reviews contribute no extracted values.

Catalyst.description: A catalyst material tested in the study, as the authors name it.

Electrolyte.description: The electrolyte (catholyte) used for the reported measurement.

ReactorSetup.description: The cell in which performance was measured.

Product.description: A reduction product as reported (CO, formate, C2H4, ethanol, CH4, H2 ...).

PerformanceMetric.description: One measured or computed performance value.

CharacterizationMethod.description: A technique used to characterize the catalyst or the reaction (operando XAS, Raman, XPS, DFT ...).

Intermediate.description: A reaction intermediate the authors identify (*CO, *COOH, *OCHO ...).

FOR_PRODUCT.description: The value refers to this product.

MEASURED_UNDER.description: The value was measured under these conditions.

TESTED_IN.description: The catalyst was tested in this electrolyte.

OPERATED_IN.description: The catalyst was tested in this cell.

CHARACTERIZED_BY.description: The catalyst was studied with this method.

INVOLVES_INTERMEDIATE.description: The authors identify this intermediate on the catalyst.

never_merge: the same element in different forms (Cu foil, Cu nanocubes, oxide-derived Cu, Cu(100)) are distinct catalysts
formate and formic acid stay as each paper reports them
a catalyst before and after activation or reconstruction is reported as the authors name it
faithfulness_rules: Faradaic efficiency, potential and current density of one PerformanceMetric come from the same experiment
potentials are stored against the reference electrode the paper states; never convert between references
values read from a figure (not stated in text or table) carry '(read from Fig. N)' in _citation
